<script>
(function(){
  var b64="";
  function fromB64(b){var bin=atob(b);var u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return u;}
  function apply(html){
    var d=document.createElement('div'); d.innerHTML=html;
    var style=d.querySelector('style');
    if(style) document.head.appendChild(style);
  }
  if(typeof DecompressionStream!=='undefined'){
    new Response(new Blob([fromB64(b64).buffer]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text().then(apply).catch(function(e){console.error('IQ head gunzip',e);});
  }
})();
</script>
